why: The thin figure ignores its connectivity and always walks 4-connected components, so asking for the ruling's 8-connected thin share splits a block from a cell touching it only at a corner and reads the cell as a thin component of its own. Distinct from mapgen-components-ignore-diagonals, which breaks the neighbour set for every caller: this leaves wallComponents alone. The shipped thin CELLS are the same under both connectivities, so only vs-duel-01's thin component count (2 against 4) and a diagonal fixture can see it.
